text: The following question stood in the name of  Mr Ganesh Rajaram –  9  To ask the Minister for Communications and Information (a) whether he can provide an update on the securing of broadcast rights for the 2020 Tokyo Olympics; (b) whether the rights have been secured and, if not, why, given that the event is just over two years away; and (c) whether there is a danger of Singaporeans missing out on watching the Games.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: This shows how lucrative the business of broadcasting rights has become.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: This is in no one’s interest in the long term.

speaker: Mr Kok Heng Leun
text: On behalf of Mr Ganesh, I have a supplementary question.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
text: The Government will continue to monitor the situation.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
text: Let the key players and the market decide what is the best course of action for them.
